headline: SGLang PR: Overlap KPool Planning to Cut Sync Overhead
summary: This PR optimizes GLM-5.3-Flash inference by reusing the CPU request-index mirror and specifying repeat_interleave output size to avoid device-to-host sync. It also moves query rotation earlier and overlaps non-CP prefill compression with query quantization, improving pipeline efficiency.
why_it_matters: Reduces latency by eliminating synchronization stalls and overlapping compute phases, directly improving throughput for long-context inference.

headline: SGLang Router Refactor: Bucket-Based Routing with Power-of-Two
summary: SGLang's router refactor introduces BucketResolver, Bucket, and EngineGroup to segregate requests by length and SLO. It implements length-based bucket routing with Power-of-Two selection, ensuring PD engines come from the same bucket and are dispatched only after successful selection.
why_it_matters: This architectural change improves routing efficiency and scalability in SGLang, enabling better load balancing and SLO-aware request handling for inference engines.

headline: Fixing RocketKV Cache Allocation for Tensor Parallelism
summary: TensorRT-LLM PR #19264 corrects RocketKV's KT cache allocation to use per-layer local KV heads instead of global counts, preventing memory over-allocation under tensor parallelism. A CPU regression test validates shapes and byte budgets.
why_it_matters: Ensures accurate KV cache memory budgeting in multi-GPU inference, reducing per-rank memory footprint by up to 75% for large KV head configurations.

headline: FMA Guide Renamed for Consistent Variant Pairing
summary: PR #2521 renames the fast-model-actuation guide directory to fast-model-actuation-base, aligning with its KEDA sibling. Updates paths, CI workflows, and references to maintain consistency across the guide pair.
why_it_matters: Ensures clear documentation structure for inference engineers, reducing confusion between base and KEDA variants when deploying fast model actuation.

headline: Fix for GAIE Manifest Download URL in llm-d
summary: A PR fixes incorrect download URLs for Gateway API Inference Extension manifests. The script now uses GAIE_URL to handle version-specific paths, preventing HTTP 404 errors when GAIE_VERSION defaults to 'latest'.
why_it_matters: Ensures reliable retrieval of inference extension manifests, avoiding deployment failures due to broken URLs.

headline: llm-d renames pod-snapshot guide to be cloud-agnostic
summary: PR #2525 renames the gke-pod-snapshots guide to pod-snapshot, updating paths, Helm release, labels, and namespace. The backend identifier gke_gvisor remains unchanged. This clarifies that the feature is not GKE-only.
why_it_matters: Removes GKE-specific branding, reducing confusion for inference engineers deploying pod-snapshots on other cloud platforms.

headline: Watermarkable Multi-Draft Speculative Sampling via Poisson Processes
summary: A new algorithm enables multi-draft speculative sampling with an unbiased watermark, eliminating the trade-off between inference efficiency and output provenance. It uses Poisson processes and exact list-coupling, achieving drafter invariance and strong sampling efficiency.
why_it_matters: This breaks the assumed impossibility of combining watermarking with speculative sampling, allowing inference engineers to add provenance without sacrificing latency or throughput.

headline: RheoSampling: Fixing Stochastic Decoding in Dynamic-Tree Speculative Decoding
summary: RheoSampling decouples tree construction from token verification, injecting sampled tokens into deterministic top-K slots with proxy probabilities. This enables lossless stochastic sampling in dynamic-tree methods like EAGLE-3, boosting acceptance rates and speedup across LLMs.
why_it_matters: Enables dynamic-tree speculative decoding to support stochastic sampling without losing context-aware topology, improving throughput and acceptance rates for non-greedy inference workloads.

headline: Diffusion on Consumer GPUs: Sub-Second Image Generation
summary: This paper tackles on-device diffusion by introducing an embedding translator to shrink text encoders, a sweep recipe for speed/quality/memory trade-offs, and an interactive editor achieving sub-second time-to-first-image on recent GPUs.
why_it_matters: For inference engineers, this enables memory-efficient diffusion pipelines on consumer hardware, reducing latency and footprint without sacrificing quality.

headline: Complete Neural Initializer Cuts DFT Wall Time by 25%
summary: Introduces AugNet, an equivariant model for PAW augmentation occupancies, and a spin density model, completing a reference-free electronic initializer for plane-wave DFT. Satisfies seven criteria, accelerating end-to-end simulations by ~25% on unseen structures without needing converged calculations.
why_it_matters: Demonstrates a fully ML-based initialization that eliminates iterative warm-start overhead, achieving 25% wall-time reduction in materials DFT—a blueprint for inference acceleration in scientific computing.

headline: Matrix AdaGrad: Row-wise and Column-wise Adaptive Optimization
summary: Introduces Row-AdaGrad and Column-AdaGrad, matrix-aware adaptive optimizers derived from Online Mirror Descent. They use row/column-wise gradient norms for scaling, offering tighter regret bounds than entry-wise AdaGrad and improving training stability and depth scalability.
why_it_matters: Enables more stable and efficient training of deep networks, potentially yielding better models without increasing inference cost.

headline: SpecQuant: Training-Free Speculative Decoding with Multi-Parent Quantization
summary: SpecQuant combines speculative decoding with multi-parent quantization to accelerate LLM inference without retraining. It creates INT4, FP8, and FP16 variants from a shared base model, routing simple queries to lightweight versions and complex ones to full precision. Achieves 35-43% speedup on Qwen2.5 with minimal accuracy loss.
why_it_matters: Enables adaptive, efficient on-device LLM inference by dynamically selecting quantized variants, reducing latency and memory footprint without specialized infrastructure.
